summary: Completed frontend smoke and responsive testing for the Sukhara homepage at the public URL. Core desktop/mobile navigation, planner confirmation, CTAs, cards, footer, and overflow checks passed; one destination asset and document metadata issue were found.

ui_bugs.issue: The Kashmir Unsplash URL fails to load (naturalWidth 0), producing broken images in the destination card and package card.

issues: Browser title is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of a branded Sukhara Travels title.

action_items: Replace the unavailable Kashmir image URL with a verified working travel image.
Set a branded document title such as 'Sukhara Travels & Tourism | Thoughtful Journeys'.
critical_code_review_comments: Remote Unsplash assets are used without a fallback; a failed critical image currently renders visibly broken cards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile homepage flows passed. Recheck all image naturalWidth values and document title after fixes.
rca of the issue: The Kashmir image source https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1595815771614-ade9d1e6a3e8... returns an unusable image response, while App.js has no image error fallback. The generic title is likely inherited from the HTML template because no branded title is set in the document head.
